title: FOLD: Position-Free Far Memory with Local Order for Long-Context Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.20392v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM generation through lightweight drafting and parallel verification. It is particularly promising for long inputs, where KV-cache access costs can be amortized over multiple accepted tokens. Yet most drafters are trained on short sequences and degrade on long inputs, while long-context training is costly. Existing training-free approaches restrict the context window, rescale positions, or augment recent context with retrieved distant entries. Drafters, however, read target hidden states that already encode contextual and positional information, and their lightweight architecture makes full-history attention affordable. We propose FOLD, a training-free method that preserves exact local positions and treats all distant entries as far memory at a shared position. translated_title: FOLD：面向长上下文投机解码的具有局部顺序的无位置远端记忆
translated_abstract: 投机解码通过轻量级起草与并行验证来加速大语言模型的生成。它对长输入尤其有前景，因为KV缓存的访问成本可以摊销到多个被接受的token上。然而，大多数起草器是在短序列上训练的，在长输入上性能会退化，而长上下文训练的代价高昂。现有的免训练方法要么限制上下文窗口，要么重新缩放位置，要么用检索到的远端条目来增强近期上下文。然而，起草器所读取的目标隐藏状态已经编码了上下文与位置信息，并且其轻量级架构使得全历史注意力变得可行。我们提出FOLD，一种免训练方法，它保留精确的局部位置，并将所有远端条目视为处于共享位置上的远端记忆。为应对记忆增长带来的注意力稀释问题，我们在该记忆内部锐化注意力以突出相关条目，同时单独控制其……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: FOLD是一种免训练的长上下文投机解码方法，它保留精确的局部位置，将所有远端条目作为共享位置上的远端记忆处理，并通过锐化记忆内部的注意力来缓解注意力稀释问题。
en_tdlr: FOLD is a training-free long-context speculative decoding method that preserves exact local positions, treats all distant entries as far memory at a shared position, and sharpens attention within the memory to counter attention dilution.
